day2.title: SynBio World Cafe - Session 1
day2.description: The SynBio World Café makes a special guest appearance at the SynBioReactor. Inserting its signature, group discussion-driven format directly into the program. Mirroring this year’s Reactor topics, the World Café offers attendees a hands-on opportunity to join the conversation, on: the founders journey artificial intelligence bio-scale up green chemistry bio-defense & supply chain resilience Share your perspectives, and engage directly with experts on site. Instead of lectures, this session creates space for open, moderated table discussions where participants from science, startups, industry, policy, and investment exchange ideas on real challenges and future opportunities in synthetic biology. Chose your session, contribute to the conversation and help shape collective thinking around innovation, sustainability, regulation, and commercialization.

day2.title: "Networking Isn’t the Point!" - Visibility for Life Scientists, Not Influencers
day2.description: The life sciences job market is increasingly volatile, yet many highly qualified professionals struggle to connect with the right opportunities. One reason is not a lack of expertise, but a lack of visibility. This fireside chat is for life scientists who are not natural networkers and have no interest in becoming influencers. It explores how to build professional visibility through substance rather than noise, using simple systems and habits instead of motivation or self-promotion. The session shows how thoughtful presence, consistent communication, and community engagement can create career resilience and meaningful connections—without playing the traditional networking game.
